about: The capture WAV the app writes when Dump Capture Audio is on — the same cases in every edition: the natives' recording written to the dump folder, the web's the file it hands the browser to download. Each case writes 'samples' recorded at 'sampleRate' and reads the file back: 'expect' is its header — 'format' (3, IEEE float), 'channels', 'bitsPerSample', 'sampleRate' — and its samples, which equal those written (within 1e-6).

cases.note: a recording is one channel of 32-bit floats at its own rate, its samples as recorded
the rate is the capture's (48 kHz)
